name: Ganges Lava Sea
notes: One of the most extreme magmatic zones in the setting: active volcanic rifts that cool and solidify into vast jagged black basalt plains and lava fields. Extreme zone where magma meets ocean. Deep-sea vent lineages were pushed to the surface here and evolved obsidian carapaces that withstand direct magma exposure; extremophile gastropods fuse basalt and metallic ore into armoured shells along the lake shores. The fauna are heavily armoured and heat-resistant, often fused with volcanic minerals. The bestiary groups the magmatic and glacial extremes together, with underworld portals at the far end. Species here default to rare.
